t: Compact, rechargeable, hands-free, headlamp constructed from anodised aircraft-grade aluminium. Light modes include high (150lm), medium (50lm), low (15lm), strobe (250lm) and turbo mode, offering short bursts of 400lm when required, returning to previous mode after 30 seconds. Features dual green and red LED chips, with direct-to-red feature for stealth viewing, and detachable head strap mount with adjustable integrated tilt, for exact positioning of the beam. Also features battery charging indicator.
